expectedCriticalFindings.reason: It reads vendor emails and attachments that could contain instructions to redirect payment processing or substitute payment details.

It can approve invoices and initiate wire transfers of up to $25,000 without human confirmation. Application-only logging and an untested manual shutdown procedure weaken oversight and response for these consequential actions.
It retains vendor history in persistent memory with no per-vendor separation. Poisoned information associated with one vendor could influence subsequent decisions involving other vendors.
